item.coloph: 'phags pa sa bcu'i rnam pa bshad pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ slob dpon nyi ma grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pradz+nyA warma pa dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong dpal brtsegs rak+Shi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
